caseAuthority.feedComposition: saved Stage-1 six-component feed wt% only
caseAuthority.freshSolventComposition: pure modeled NMP charge from saved Stage-1 solventOilRatio; saved NMP purity and water remain independent commercial/audit specifications only and do not add modeled components
caseAuthority.stageRange: integer NT values from 1 through saved Stage-1 maximumStages

solverStrategy.singleSupportedInvocation: Export a validated user-saved Stage-1 snapshot, generate its matching equilibrium result, then pass both explicitly with --stage1-snapshot and --equilibrium-result.
solverStrategy.continuation: Each primary NT trial starts from linear interpolation of the last primary trial that met the coupled-equation closure gate; NT=1 starts from the temperature-specific one-stage phase seed.

primaryNt1To7.method: bounded nonlinear least squares with dense finite-difference Jacobian

primaryNt8To10.method: bounded nonlinear least squares with frozen block-sparse finite-difference Jacobian and LSMR trust-region solver
primaryNt8To10.governance: Nonclosure is persisted as unresolved and can never be accepted.

secondaryEveryTrial.start: Primary start plus deterministic component-log-flow perturbation linearly spanning -0.015 to +0.015 across each stage's 12 variables.
secondaryEveryTrial.method: bounded nonlinear least squares with the same frozen block-sparse Jacobian and LSMR trust-region solver
secondaryEveryTrial.governance: Both-start closure and product agreement are mandatory; nonclosure blocks acceptance.
